summary: Recent advancements in AI highlight significant practical applications and collaborations. OpenAI's Stampli has dramatically cut its production timeline by 68% using ChatGPT Work, showcasing the efficiency of AI in real-world projects. Microsoft Research's Skala 1.1 enhances computational chemistry through improved predictive capabilities, while Hugging Face focuses on optimizing speech recognition systems for better accuracy. Additionally, Google DeepMind's partnership with game studios aims to innovate AI gameplay experiences, reflecting a trend towards collaborative research in the gaming industry. These developments underline the growing impact of AI technologies across various sectors.

items.original: From Atari to EVE Online: Building on 15 Years of AI Research in Games. Google DeepMind partners with game studios to prototype breakthrough AI gameplay.
items.rewritten: Google DeepMind has been conducting AI research in gaming for 15 years and is now collaborating with game studios to develop innovative AI gameplay experiences. Their work spans various games, including popular titles like Atari and EVE Online.

items.original: Measuring benchmark optimization in speech recognition
items.rewritten: Hugging Face is focused on improving speech recognition technology by measuring and optimizing benchmark performance. This research aims to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of speech recognition systems.

items.original: Broadening access to Skala creates a faster path to predictive DFT. Skala 1.1, the updated deep-learning exchange-correlation functional from Microsoft Research, provides greater accuracy, expanded accessibility across the computational chemistry ecosystem, and a living benchmark to track computational performance. The post Broadening access to Skala creates a faster path to predictive DFT appeared first on Microsoft Research .
items.rewritten: Microsoft Research has released Skala 1.1, an updated deep-learning tool that enhances predictive density functional theory (DFT) in computational chemistry. This version offers improved accuracy and broader accessibility, serving as a benchmark for evaluating computational performance in the field.

items.original: Fund Momentum MCP: Live VC Fund Data for AI Agents
items.rewritten: Fund Momentum MCP provides real-time data on venture capital funds specifically designed for AI agents. This platform allows users to access live information, enhancing decision-making for investments in the AI sector.

items.original: Launch HN: Tokenless (YC S26) – Automatic model switching to save money
items.rewritten: Tokenless, a startup from Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch, offers automatic model switching to help users save on costs. This innovative feature allows users to optimize their expenses without needing to manage tokens manually.

items.original: Stampli cuts launch hours by 68% using ChatGPT Work. With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.
items.rewritten: Stampli has successfully reduced its launch hours by 68% by utilizing ChatGPT Work. With a tight deadline and limited design resources, they leveraged Codex and ChatGPT Work to accelerate their production timeline from weeks to just days.

items.original: Introducing AI Futures. Introducing AI Futures, a new OpenAI blog exploring how transformative AI could reshape power, governance, the economy, and individual freedom.
items.rewritten: OpenAI has launched a new blog called AI Futures, which examines the potential impact of transformative AI on various aspects of society, including power, governance, the economy, and personal freedoms. This platform aims to foster discussions about the future shaped by AI.

items.original: Show HN: Diffusion PDF – A Diffusion Image Model Embedded Entirely in a PDF File
items.rewritten: Diffusion PDF is a tool that allows users to create images using a diffusion model, all contained within a single PDF file. This means you can generate and manipulate images without needing additional software. It's a convenient way to share and present your work.

items.original: Aquila Voice Assistant Test Suite for Home Assistant
items.rewritten: The Aquila Voice Assistant Test Suite is a tool designed for testing voice assistant functionalities within the Home Assistant platform. It helps developers ensure that their voice commands and interactions work as intended. This is crucial for creating a seamless user experience.

items.original: Show HN: Alyph, a manual transmission for LLM context
items.rewritten: Alyph is a tool designed to enhance the context management of large language models (LLMs) through manual transmission. It allows users to have more control over the information being processed by the model. This can improve the relevance and accuracy of the responses generated.
